items.title: Earnings Beat Might Change The Case For Investing In Ameren Stock (AEE)
items.summary: Ameren reported third quarter 2026 net income of $676 million, or $2.42 per diluted share, alongside revenue of $2.88 billion. The company raised its 2026 earnings guidance to $5.35 to $5.55 per share and issued 2027 guidance of $5.70 to $5.90 per share. Management tied the earnings beat and higher guidance to infrastructure investment and higher electric retail sales, signaling that Ameren’s regulated capital program and demand backdrop are already feeding through to current profitability...
